comment: What the browser build loads, read by site/loader.mjs for both site/worker.js and tests/pyodide/run.mjs. 'packages' come before the first frame; 'later' (DuckDB, 8.5 MB, only for SQL) loads after it. 'drop' is left out of Pyodide's lockfile: nothing on the page imports pandas, and the demo's catalog is icelens.memory rather than SQLite, so SQLAlchemy is not needed either. Textual and icelens are listed in wheels/latest.json, which scripts/build_site.py writes. icelens runs below its own dependency floors here (see docs/PLATFORMS.md).
